intro: Razzeric has found that Shreev left the safety on the seaforium booster. It caps the power Razzeric gets out of the booster, and Razzeric had asked for it to be taken off. You are sent to Shreev in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: But wait, what's this? Shreev left the safety on. That will limit the amount of power I can draw from the booster at any time. I told him I wanted it off! This is no good.
You have to take this to the Gadgetzan Gizmorium in the Tanaris Desert and have Shreev remove this.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As I'm sure you know, the Gizmorium can service all of your tinkering needs! How can I help you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Only Razzeric would take a look at this and say that I'd somehow put some sort of safety lock on it. This booster is almost completely seaforium explosives. I already modified it so that more of its payload would be delivered upon use, but Razzeric is never content unless he goes to eleven!
